duration.text: The Nanomaterials and Nanotechnology at Nanjing University of Science and Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2750 USD/per year ￥ 19800 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Passport: Front page of the passport (with a validity period of more than 12 months). 2. Academic Certificate: Notarized certificate of the highest academic degree; if the applicant is a recent graduate, a projected graduation certificate or student status certificate from the school should be provided. 3. Transcript: Official transcript from the high school years (with the school's academic department seal). If the transcript is not in both Chinese and English, an English translation certified by a notary must be attached. 4. Language proficiency certificate: Provide a valid language test score certificate within the last two years (such as HSK, TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo). 5. Personal Statement: Motivation for academic and professional choices, more than 800 words (in Chinese or English). Click to download the personal statement template. 6. Recommendation Letters: Submit two recommendation letters from the teachers of the applicant's high school, and clearly state the relationship between the teachers and the applicant. 7. "Foreigner Physical Examination Form": Copy (Original should be kept by the applicant. This form is uniformly printed by the Chinese Health Quarantine Department and must be filled out in English). Applicants must conduct the examination strictly in accordance with the items required in the "Foreigner Physical Examination Form". Any missing items, those without a photo attached or without a seam seal on the photo, or those without the signatures and stamps of a doctor and hospital are invalid. The validity period of the examination results is 6 months. Click to download the Foreigner Physical Examination Form 8. Certificate of No Criminal Record: Issued by the local public security authority. The document must be valid within the last 6 months prior to the application. 9. Financial proof: Provide financial guarantee materials (such as income certificates from parents or guardians, deposit certificates, or guarantee letters). 10. Other materials: Such as award certificates, proof of special skills, and other supplementary documents.

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens who are in good physical and mental health, have a strong academic background, consciously abide by Chinese laws and school regulations, and respect Chinese customs and traditions. 2. Language proficiency requirements: ● English language instruction: IELTS 5.5, TOEFL 80 points, Duolingo 90 points or equivalent level ● Chinese language instruction: HSK Level 4 or above 3. Education and Age Requirements: High school graduation, age not exceeding 26 years old
